$comment: Lab configuration used by 'azd up' (infra/scripts/build_config.py turns it into the Bicep parameters). Mirrors step 0 of the notebook: change models, plans, prices and agents here.

tiers.name: gold
tiers.description: Premium plan: every model, every MCP tool (incl. premium data), the Sourcing Agent, generous limits

tiers.name: silver
tiers.description: Standard plan: cost-efficient models, standard MCP tools, the Sourcing Agent; premium requests are downgraded

tiers.name: bronze
tiers.description: Low-cost plan: nano model only, catalog search tool only, no agents, tight token limits

tiers.name: agent-platform
tiers.description: Internal plan for platform agents: their model and tool calls are charged back to the calling subscription

endUserBudgets.$comment: Per-end-user $ budgets inside one subscription: an app sends x-gw-end-user and every user gets their own cap, while the plan budget still caps the app's total. Users get a class (in production: an Entra app role or group) or an individual USD override; unlisted users get defaultClass. Deployed as the end-user-budgets named value, so it can change without a policy redeploy.

contentSafety.$comment: Blocked before spend (ON for azd up; set enabled to false to skip it. The notebook keeps it off by default): Azure AI Content Safety screens prompts, MCP tool arguments and A2A tasks at the gateway before any spend (plans opt in with contentSafety: true). The check is charged to the plan $ budget at pricePer1KRecordsUsd per 1,000 text records (1 record = up to 1,000 characters; Prompt Shields analyzes the text a second time), about $0.0008 per call, which makes Silver's $0.01 budget run out a call or two sooner.

purviewDlp.$comment: OPTIONAL Microsoft Purview DLP (Graph processContent on behalf of the signed-in user). Off by default: it needs real Entra users, an app registration with admin-consented Graph permissions, a client secret (PURVIEW_CLIENT_SECRET) and a Purview DLP policy for custom AI apps. See the README.

budgetSuspend.$comment: Over budget, switched off: the first blocked subscription-budget call triggers a Logic App directly to suspend watched subscriptions. No periodic spend scans. ON for azd up; set enabled=false to skip it (the notebook keeps it off by default). Only exhaustion is supported (not custom percentages or email notifications). useCustomRole=true needs Owner or User Access Administrator; false uses API Management Service Contributor on this APIM instance.

entraMode.$comment: OPTIONAL Entra-only mode (azd up; off by default). Adds a key-less copy of the models API (entra/inference/openai/v1, no APIM subscription) where the plan and the $ budgets come from Microsoft Entra ID: a gateway app registration (app role Gateway.Invoke), one security group per team (tier, a shared team budgetUsd and a per-member memberBudgetUsd cap) and one user-assigned managed identity per persona, attached to the hosted UI. Groups reach the gateway in the token's groups claim (groupMembershipClaims: SecurityGroup), mapped to plans by the entra-gateway-groups named value. Needs permission to create app registrations and security groups. includeDeployerIn adds the azd user to one group (tokens of users in more than 200 groups carry no groups claim). The demo UI shows the 'Entra only' toggle when this is deployed.

tools.name: check-inventory
tools.description: Stock level of a SKU per warehouse

tools.name: get-supplier-quote
tools.description: Premium: live supplier quotes for a SKU and quantity

a2aAgents.name: sourcing-agent
a2aAgents.description: Sources a product: searches the catalog, checks stock, gets supplier quotes and recommends a supplier

responses.$comment: Responses API (POST /responses, previous_response_id, stored responses). Cached input tokens are priced at cachedInputPrices (USD per 1M tokens); models not listed pay the full input price. Reading a stored response (GET /responses/{id}) is free. Follow-up calls stick to the backend that stored the response.

images.$comment: Image generation priced per image (USD) by model, quality and size, charged to the same plan $ budget. Off by default: enabling it deploys the model in the priority-1 region only (gpt-image models are not available in francecentral). Prices are illustrative list prices: check the Azure OpenAI pricing page.

semanticCache.$comment: Semantic cache (ON for azd up; set enabled to false to skip it. The notebook keeps it off by default): single-turn chat completions from the listed plans are embedded with embeddingsModel (deployed in the priority-1 region only) and looked up in Azure Managed Redis (RediSearch module, the APIM external cache). A stored answer within scoreThreshold (vector distance: lower is stricter) is returned without calling the model. Who may reuse an answer is the cache SCOPE: session (only the same subscription + end user + x-session-id), user (the same subscription + end user, any session) or plan (shared by every caller of the plan). Apps pick one of allowedScopes per request with the x-gw-cache-scope header; otherwise defaultScope applies. Every scope is also partitioned by plan, served model, budget epoch (Reset budgets starts a cold cache) and a hash of the system/developer messages, and entries expire after ttlSeconds. A hit is charged only the embedding lookup (embeddingPricePer1MTokensUsd); a miss pays the model plus the lookup. Azure Managed Redis bills per hour while deployed: Balanced_B0 is the smallest SKU.
